subject: general
question: Sumit, Jatin, Ramesh, Priya, Kavita and Manoj are sitting in a straight line, facing north. Sumit sits third from the left end. Manoj sits second to the right of Sumit. Jatin sits to the immediate left of Kavita. Priya does not sit at the end. Who sits second to the left of Priya?
solution:
Sumit, Jatin, Ramesh, Priya, Kavita and Manoj are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

 
• Sumit sits third from the left end.
 
• Manoj sits second to the right of Sumit.
 
• Jatin sits to the immediate left of Kavita.
 
• Priya does not sit at the end.
